content.description: Rear window defogger switch wiring diagram showing terminals 1-8 with battery connection and switch position indicator

content.text: INSPECTION OF REAR WINDOW DEFOGGER SWITCH

items: (a) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 5. Connect the negative (−) lead to terminal 6.
(b) Connect an ohmmeter between terminals 2 and 6.
(c) Check that there is continuity between terminals for 10 − 20 minutes with the switch turned on.

content.text: If operation is not as specified, replace the switch.

content.description: Two relay diagrams showing 'No continuity' and 'Continuity' states with terminal connections 1-4

content.text: INSPECTION OF REAR WINDOW DEFOGGER RELAY

items: (a) Check that the there is continuity between terminals 1 and 3.
(b) Check that there is no continuity between terminals 2 and 4.

content.text: If continuity is not as specified, replace the relay.
Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 1 and connect the negative (−) lead from the battery to terminal 3. Then, check that there is continuity between terminals 2 and 4.
If operation is not as specified, replace the relay.
